name: Northern Midlands & Mountains
climate: A real winter in the high towns, cool and often dry from November to April, then hot and wet from May to September.
days: Give the mountains at least two nights. Sapa, Ha Giang, and Mai Chau are separate loops.
summary: The far-north mountains: Sapa, Ha Giang, and Mai Chau, where winter nights can approach freezing and the high terraces turn gold in summer.
body: This is the mountainous part of the north. Winter nights above Sapa can approach freezing. Summer is hot, humid, and stormy, which is also when the rice on the high terraces turns green and then gold.
Sapa, the Ha Giang loop, and Mai Chau are different roads. Give the mountains at least two nights. Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, and Ninh Binh are the Red River Delta, not these hills.
seoTitle: Northern Midlands and Mountains travel guide
seoDescription: Sapa, Ha Giang, and Mai Chau: mountain weather, how many nights, and how this region sits apart from Hanoi.
